mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, it is 60 degrees with overcast skies near the Reddan Soccer Park and a full moon is currently visible.

The City of Verona has issued a scam alert warning residents about fake emails requesting planning application fees online, reminding everyone to only pay by check at the City Administration Building; meanwhile, public works crews are gearing up for fall leaf collection starting October 5.

There is plenty to do in Verona with the Verona Fall Fest, live music at Bailey's Run, and entertainment at the Wisconsin Brewing Company all happening today, plus the Dane County Farmers' Market on the square happens tomorrow.
In a noteworthy call from September 10, officers responded to a burglary in progress at Hunters Cove Way where a suspect was apprehended after a shot was fired during the incident.
Culver's of Verona will open today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to stop by and treat yourself to today's flavor of the day.
